variants.name: ew
variants.note: control: policy_v4 as it is, equal weight capped at HOLD_CAP

variants.name: inv-vol-forecast
variants.note: held names weighted 1 / sigma from the CNN forecast, same total invested, cap 0.20

variants.name: inv-vol-trailing
variants.note: the same with the trailing-20-session realized volatility

variants.name: vol-target-forecast
variants.note: equal weights, exposure scaled to the volatility target from the CNN forecast, no leverage

variants.name: vol-target-trailing
variants.note: the same with the trailing baseline

variants.name: hybrid-forecast
variants.note: inverse-volatility weights then the volatility target, both from the CNN forecast

variants.name: hybrid-trailing
variants.note: the same with the trailing baseline

vol_target.definition: median over the choosing window of sum_i w_i * sigma_i on the control's own target weights, sigma_i = exp(log realized variance of the next session / 2), sessions where every held name has a value

note: Every non-control variant is one registered trial, fixed in VARIANTS before the run. Each wraps policy_v4's allocator and rescales its weights; a held name with no sigma keeps the control's weight and is counted in fallback_share. Priced under plain next-open fills and under the live execution policy on identical sessions from each of the first `offsets` sessions; medians and worsts are across offsets; paired statistics at the median offset against the control under the same options and against the trailing twin. The verdict reads live at 25 bp.

verdict.text: 2016-2023 at 25 bp under live options: control 23.2% (maxDD -36.0%, ratio 0.65); volatility target 0.0138 per session. inv-vol-forecast -0.3 pt (t -1.76, maxDD -35.8% vs -36.0%, vs twin +0.2 pt, fallback 32%) RECORD; inv-vol-trailing -0.6 pt (t -1.87, maxDD -35.7% vs -36.0%, fallback 6%) RECORD; vol-target-forecast -0.4 pt (t -1.08, maxDD -34.0% vs -36.0%, vs twin +0.8 pt, fallback 32%) RECORD; vol-target-trailing -1.2 pt (t -1.14, maxDD -33.7% vs -36.0%, fallback 6%) RECORD; hybrid-forecast -0.9 pt (t -1.67, maxDD -34.0% vs -36.0%, vs twin +0.7 pt, fallback 32%) RECORD; hybrid-trailing -1.6 pt (t -1.25, maxDD -33.6% vs -36.0%, fallback 6%) RECORD. No forecast variant clears 1 pt with t >= 2, drawdown not worse, not worse on 2024-2026, and 0.5 pt over its trailing twin; every variant is RECORD.
